_comment: E12 observation set. Real LIBERO frames from the SAME source as bench/fixtures/observation.json (the HuggingFaceVLA/libero dataset through the datasets-server rows API), not re-rendered. They exist because docs/E12_corun/README.md §6.1 requires several materially different observations: with one observation per frame the expert's KV would be identical every frame and a stale-KV bug would be invisible, which would leave the fresh-KV check with no power and every E12 number ungated.
